title: A New Look at the Visual Performance of Nonparametric Hazard Rate Estimators
summary: Nonparametric curve estimation by kernel methods has attracted widespread interest in theoretical and applied statistics. One area of conflict between theory and application relates to the evaluation of the performance of the estimators. Recently, Marron and Tsybakov (1995) proposed {\it visual error criteria} for addressing this issue of controversy in density estimation. Their core idea consists in using integrated alternatives to the Hausdorff distance for measuring the closeness of two sets based onthe Euclidean distance. In this paper, we transfer these ideas to hazard rate estimation…
